Senior Propulsion Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Propulsion Engineer to own solid rocket motor propulsion projects from requirements through design, manufacture, testing, iteration, and production readiness. This is an end-to-end role for an engineer who wants to see a product through to a working result rather than owning only one isolated part of the design process.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own small-to-medium propulsion projects from requirements definition to tested and production-ready hardware.

  • Perform and review design and analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, performance, nozzles, structures, and motor cases.

  • Coordinate design, manufacture, assembly, instrumentation, static-fire testing, post-test analysis, and redesign.

  • Work with chemistry and manufacturing teams to select materials and propellant solutions that meet performance and production requirements.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, and analysis reports.

  • Support qualification, customer demonstrations, productionisation, and the development of junior engineers.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in aerospace, mechanical, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Professional experience in propulsion, aerospace hardware, experimental engineering, or a closely related field.

  • The ability to take ownership of a technical problem or project and carry it through to a working result.

  • Working knowledge of several propulsion disciplines, combined with strong engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience moving between computer-based analysis and hands-on work with hardware.

  • A proactive, self-managing approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving team.

Desirable experience

  • Direct experience designing, manufacturing, or testing solid rocket motors.

  • Propellant formulation, characterisation, or energetic materials.

  • Static-fire testing and analysis of pressure, force, temperature, or other instrumentation data.

  • Vehicle-level launch-vehicle design, productionisation, or qualification.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: $110K – $140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

You'll help build the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform, working across the full lifecycle – from pipeline design to production deployment. With 5+ years of experience under your belt, you're ready for the next step in your career. Maybe you've already mentored or technically guided colleagues, and you're looking to grow steadily into a Team Lead role as you take on more ownership and, over time, people responsibility.

The Technical ChallengeYou'll work on problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents you've never seen before, and where every accuracy gain has a direct, visible impact on our customers' daily operations.


Your Mission

  • Lead MLOps processes and maintain infrastructure to keep our AI systems reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Design and implement advanced AI features, working closely with engineering and product teams to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Improve the accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of existing AI features through rigorous testing
  • Contribute to the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and help build new ones from scratch
  • Align your technical work with customer needs and support product and sales discussions
  • Help establish engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices
  • Mentor and technically guide colleagues as you build the track record to grow into a leadership role
  • Use modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor as part of your daily workflow


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Ideally, some experience mentoring or technically guiding others – and the ambition to grow into a Team Lead role
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
  • EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
  • Fair, competitive compensation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d) for Storage24
description:
Your mission

Build the next digital generation of Storage24

Storage24 is the European leader in XXL self-storage and flexible space solutions. After rapid expansion, we are now building a data-driven, scalable digital platform.

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who thrives with high autonomy, takes ownership without being told twice, and delivers real impact — someone who's built things in a vibrant, fast-moving, ideally startup environment and knows how to figure things out when the path isn't fully mapped out yet.

You'll work closely with Product and business leadership and take end-to-end ownership of key platform initiatives. You will:
- Build and extend platform features & internal tools
- Design and optimize data pipelines & integrations
- Operate scalable services on Google Cloud
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines & deployment environments
- Ensure quality through testing and code reviews

This is not a ticket role. It's architecture, ownership, and shipped value — you'll often get direction on the what, not the how, and we expect you to run with that.


Your profile

Technical Expertise
- 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer (or equivalent hands-on depth — we value real coding experience over titles)
- Strong experience with modern TypeScript & React
- Confident working with SQL and data modeling
- Experience building and operating services in Google Cloud
- Familiar with Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD workflows
- Comfortable designing APIs, integrations, and scalable architectures
- Fluent in English (German or French is a plus)

Nice to have: HubSpot, n8n, BigQuery, Docker, Tailwind, ETL/data engineering, event-driven systems.

Mindset
- You've worked in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — startup experience strongly preferred — and know what it's like when priorities shift daily and nobody hands you a spec
- You take senior-level ownership end-to-end, and you don't wait around for instructions to get started
- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and taking initiative without being asked
- You think in products and outcomes, not just features
- You choose pragmatic solutions over over-engineering
- You stay curious and leverage modern tools (including AI) to improve quality and speed


This is who we are

- Real ownership and direct influence on architectural decisions
- Direct impact on customer success and operational efficiency
- Opportunity to work with motivated stakeholders across the business
- Modern stack without legacy baggage
- Short decision-making paths, high autonomy and collaborative culture
- Hybrid setup: Munich office + 2 remote days
- Competitive compensation and attractive benefits (pension plan, bike leasing, corporate benefits, and more)

description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind?

In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern: Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen.
  • Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten: Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten.
  • Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern: Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten.
  • Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln: Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben.
  • Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen: Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft.
  • Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist.
  • Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht.
  • Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen.
  • Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet.
  • Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio).
  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.
  • Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Nutze die Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen und Wachstum durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.
  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Flexible steuerfreie Benefits: Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann.


Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.


Kontakt

title: Working Student – IT Support & Systems
description:
Your mission

planqc builds neutral atom quantum computers in Garching. Behind every experiment and every line of control software sits an IT setup that has to work: laptops that are ready on day one, accounts that exist when someone starts, and hardware that is where it should be.
As a Working Student in IT Support & Systems, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues who need IT help. You handle 1st level support, prepare and hand over equipment, and keep our Microsoft 365 environment and IT documentation in order. You also support onboarding and offboarding from the IT side, so new colleagues can start working immediately.
This role suits a student who wants real hands on experience with infrastructure and admin tools, and who enjoys helping people as much as fixing systems.


Your responsibilities

  • Provide 1st level IT support for employees and troubleshoot common hardware, software and access issues
  • Support hardware procurement: ordering, tracking and preparing laptops, monitors and accessories
  • Manage the equipment lifecycle, from setup for new starters to collection and reset for leavers
  • Support IT onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, access, devices and the welcome setup
  • Handle day to day Microsoft 365 tasks such as mailboxes, distribution lists and Teams/SharePoint access
  • Keep IT documentation accurate and up to date, including guides, inventory lists and onboarding checklists
  • Work with your IT colleagues on more complex issues and escalate when needed


What you bring

  • Enrolled in an IT related degree program such as Computer Science or Information Systems, any semester
  • Genuine interest in IT and in how systems and infrastructure work
  • Basic computer literacy with Windows or macOS and solid troubleshooting instincts
  • Ability to pick up new tools quickly and to ask questions when something is unclear
  • Reliable and organized, with clear communication towards colleagues without an IT background


Nice to have

  • Hobby level experience with Windows or macOS troubleshooting, home networking or similar
  • Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools such as Outlook, SharePoint and Teams
  • Interest in growing into a junior or full System Administrator role over time


What characterizes you

  • You are curious and eager to learn. You do not need to know everything on day one
  • You are friendly and patient when helping colleagues who are less confident with technology
  • You are detail oriented, especially with equipment tracking and onboarding steps
  • You take ownership of small tasks and follow through


Why join planqc

At planqc, you will work on one of the most promising quantum computing architectures alongside a highly driven and collaborative team spanning physics, engineering, and software.
We combine deep-tech research with an engineering mindset, turning scientific breakthroughs into scalable quantum systems.
Joining us means:

  • Working on cutting-edge neutral atom quantum hardware
  • Collaborating with an exceptional, international team across disciplines
  • Contributing to a fast-growing quantum startup at a pivotal stage
 
Benefits at planqc
  • Flexible working. Flexible hours and hybrid work where the role allows.
  • Health and fitness. EGYM Wellpass for gyms, pools and studios, plus regular Health Days.
  • Learning and development. Trainings and conference participation, including international conferences. Plus regular internal learning sessions where colleagues share their knowledge.
  • Four locations. Headquarters in Garching, an office in central Munich, plus sites in Ulm and Innsbruck.
  • Team culture. Regular team and company events throughout the year, from after work socials to our summer and Christmas parties.
If you're excited about keeping the people and systems of a quantum computing company running while you study, we'd love to hear from you.

Du willst erleben, wie aus einer Idee eine Kampagne, aus einem Kontakt ein Kunde und aus Technologie echtes Business wird? Dann könnte nerdware gut zu dir passen.

  • neugierig bist und gerne neue Dinge ausprobierst,
  • dich für Marketing, Vertrieb und Technologie interessierst,
  • gerne kommunizierst und keine Scheu vor Menschen hast,
  • strukturiert und eigenständig arbeitest,
  • Verantwortung übernimmst und Dinge auch mal selbst anstößt,

  • Erste Erfahrungen in Marketing, Vertrieb, Social Media oder Content Creation

description:
Über uns

Ohne Speicher keine Energiewende.

ju:niz Energy entwickelt und betreibt seit über zehn Jahren netzdienliche Großbatteriespeicher. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz und schaffen die Flexibilität, die eine Energieversorgung mit erneuerbaren Energien braucht. Wir investieren selbst in unsere Projekte und behalten die Speicher langfristig im Bestand.

Für unser Operations-Team suchen wir dich als Servicetechniker (m/w/d). Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen sicher und zuverlässig laufen. Du kannst überall in Deutschland wohnen: Von deinem Wohnort aus betreust du unsere Anlagen im gesamten Bundesgebiet. Je nach Einsatzplanung gehören auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung dazu. Aufgaben, die keine Anwesenheit an der Anlage erfordern, kannst du von zu Hause erledigen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • An unseren Großbatteriespeichern und elektrotechnischen Nebenanlagen führst du Wartungen, Inspektionen und Instandsetzungen durch.
  • Tritt eine Störung auf, grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein, behebst den Fehler und tauschst bei Bedarf Komponenten aus – vor Ort oder, soweit möglich, per Fernzugriff.
  • Mithilfe von SCADA-, EMS- und Fernwirksystemen überwachst und parametrierst du unsere Anlagen.
  • Bei Inbetriebnahmen, Funktionstests, Netztests und Upgrades bringst du deine technische Erfahrung ein und führst Prüfungen im Rahmen deiner Qualifikation durch.
  • Deine Einsätze, Messergebnisse und Lösungen hältst du nachvollziehbar fest. Wiederkehrende Fehler und Verbesserungspotenziale besprichst du mit dem Operations-Team, damit unsere Anlagen langfristig zuverlässig laufen.

Dein Profil

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im elektrotechnischen Bereich bildet deine Grundlage – zum Beispiel als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Mechatroniker mit elektrotechnischer Erfahrung.
  • In der Wartung oder Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen, industrieller Steuerungen oder Energieanlagen hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt. Kenntnisse von Batteriespeichern sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Schaltpläne und technische Dokumentation liest du sicher; bei der Fehlersuche gehst du strukturiert vor.
  • Erfahrung mit EMSR-Technik, SCADA, EMS oder Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus und IEC 61850 ist ein Plus.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.
  • Für Einsätze an unseren Anlagen reist du innerhalb Deutschlands. Auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung sind für dich grundsätzlich möglich.

Warum wir?

  • Technik mit Wirkung: Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, dass Großbatteriespeicher zuverlässig funktionieren und das Stromnetz stabilisieren.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze: Dich erwarten unterschiedliche Anlagen und Aufgaben – von der Fehleranalyse bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
  • Deutschlandweiter Einstieg: Dein Wohnort muss nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Aschheim liegen.
  • Fachliche Entwicklung: Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in der Batterietechnik und im Anlagenbetrieb weiter ausbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit einem kollegialen Team und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

Alecto is the UK's first AI-native law firm.

 

Our mission is to make the law accessible to everyone on the planet. We believe that the quality of service currently offered by the legal profession is woefully inadequate. It delivers bad value for money, frustrates the people it exists to serve, and lacks basic accountability.

We believe that a law firm should:

  • Speak in language people actually understand.

Backed by Firstminute Capital and a strong group of angel investors, we’re led by a founder who built and scaled Gen H, a fintech mortgage lender, to £1bn in annual lending and £5bn in financing. Our ambition is to build a full-service, AI-first law firm with global reach.

The Role

We're hiring qualified residential conveyancers of all experience levels to manage purchase and sale transactions in England & Wales.

You’ll be expected to manage high-volume caseloads while delivering outstanding legal work and customer service. You'll work with proprietary AI tools that handle routine tasks, freeing you to focus on complex legal issues and client relationships.

  • Location: Work from home as standard, with the option to work from our London office.

  • Fast pace: We move quickly. Our technology evolves rapidly. You'll need to adapt and embrace continuous improvement.

  • Transparent assessment: Your performance will be measured across quality of legal work, customer satisfaction scores, transaction speed, and case volume. All metrics are clearly defined and tracked.

  • Direct feedback: You'll get thoughtful feedback regularly, with monthly performance reviews.

  • Career progression: Advancement and pay increases are based entirely on results delivered, not tenure or other attributes.

Who Thrives Here

We’d love to talk to you if you’re:

  • Relentless: You're never satisfied with good enough. You push yourself to improve constantly, and you measure your progress.

  • Uncompromising: You have incredibly high standards. You sweat the details. You take pride in your work even when no one's watching. You speak up when standards slip.

  • Optimistic: You approach problems as solvable. You find opportunity in challenges. You energise and elevate the people around you.

And you believe that

  • Change is coming and carries huge potential with it.

title: Lead ClickHouse Engineer
description:
Lead ClickHouse Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

 

The Role

We're looking for a Lead ClickHouse Engineer to own our data plant: a multi-datacentre, multi-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real-time and historical analytics.

This is a core-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll own the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also set direction and work on the data pipelines around the plant — our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.

Beyond your own technical ownership, you'll set the standard for how the estate is run, mentor the engineers who work alongside you, and ensure the plant is genuinely supportable by a team rather than dependent on any one person — including yourself.

You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically — deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.

This hire helps create a follow-the-sun team — so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid — not goodwill.

What You'll Work On

  • Cluster operations at scale — running, upgrading and evolving a multi-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery

  • Schema and query engineering — table and sorting-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi-terabyte datasets

  • Capacity and observability — a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible

  • Ingestion and data quality — correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped

  • Workload isolation — keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows

  • Team and knowledge leadership — mentoring the engineer(s) working on the estate, setting standards for runbooks and documentation, and making the plant supportable by the team, not the author

  • AI-assisted operations — modern tooling (including MCP-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

What We Need

Technical:

  • Columnar/OLAP database engineering — ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb+ or similar) also works

  • A track record of owning architectural decisions for a production data platform, not just operating within one someone else designed

  • SQL depth — execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets

  • Operational/SRE experience — you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery

  • Linux and Kubernetes — comfort with the operational layer beneath the database

  • A programming language — one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)

  • Engineering discipline — you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly

  • Git — excellent version-control practice

  • Distributed-systems fundamentals — replication, consistency, failure modes

  • Financial services experience is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You own production. Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong

  • You measure first. Topology, storage and optimisation decisions follow observed load and cost — not fashion

  • You write things down. Runbooks, schema documentation and clean handovers are part of the craft

  • You share knowledge deliberately. The goal is a platform supportable by a team, not a specialist

  • You communicate across time zones. Follow-the-sun only works with clear, proactive handovers

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use it to amplify your own effectiveness and help shape how it operates safely around production data

What You Get

  • A serious estate — genuine scale, genuine criticality: the system of record for a live trading network, not a reporting sidecar

  • Real ownership — architectural and technical leadership of a business-critical core platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Sustainable operations — follow-the-sun coverage by design; on-call is shared, contracted and planned, not heroics

  • Competitive package — competitive compensation and benefits aligned to your local market

  • Modern tooling — AI-assisted operations and investigation tooling that removes toil rather than adding process

  • Growth — the estate is scaling to multiples of today's volume; the role grows with it

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the country associated with the location advertised for this role (UK or Singapore, as applicable). We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any location.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

title: VP Finance
description:
Can you help us fix the world’s most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill — not because people don’t want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We’re building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade — through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort — an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion — that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We’re looking for people who want to build something that matters — and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

The VP Finance will be a core part of Fleek’s leadership team, responsible for bringing financial discipline into the business to ready it for further rapid scale. This finance leader will build on and professionalise Fleek’s finance operations, thinking commercially across the business, and supporting on future fundraising.

What you’ll Own

  • Building, leading and developing Fleek’s finance function globally

  • Owning company-wide financial planning and analysis, cash flow forecasting, and budgeting

  • Instilling rigorous financial controls, hygiene, and compliance in a rapidly scaling organisation

  • Driving strategy alongside the founders by turning financial data into decision-making tools

  • Building the best payment experience for Fleek’s retailers and suppliers,

  • Maintaining a strong bottom-line and financial stability for the business

  • Leading and growing finance teams in Pakistan (fin-ops), India (accounting/reporting), and UK (commercial finance)

  • Supporting future fundraising efforts and investor relations

Who We’re Looking For

  • Experience in scaling the financial function from Series A through to Series C stage (or beyond)

  • Hands on leadership in finance strategy, controls, and operations

  • Ability to hire and retain world-class talent

  • Demonstrated ability to set up and scale core finance processes

  • Strong understanding of long cash cycles, forecasting, and working capital

  • Global finance experience - managing cross-border payments and multi-currency operations

  • Fintech knowledge beneficial (especially around credit, payment processing)

  • Strong commercial and product instincts - viewing Finance as a growth function

  • Previous experience in supporting on fundraising

  • Startup mentality and intellectual curiosity - thriving in high autonomy and ambition environments

  • Deeply analytical: data-driven decision making is second nature

  • Insatiably curious: you're constantly learning about new tools, approaches, and market changes

  • Hungry and ambitious: you're driven to stay relevant and push boundaries

  • Change agent: you've driven transformation in previous organizations

  • Hands-on: you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and do the work yourself

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We believe the best work happens when people are together — the quick decisions, the cross-functional energy, the ability to solve problems in real time. Most of the team works from our London HQ 4 days a week.

We’re not prescriptive about it. Performance and trust matter more than attendance. For your first six months, we’ll ask you to prioritise being in the office, to learn the business, build relationships, and get up to speed. After that, you’ll have genuine flexibility to manage your own time. We hire adults and treat them accordingly.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ — Heneage Street, E1 (Shoreditch / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: In Person, with trust based flexibility

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan (~20 in London office)

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you’re building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn’t done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don’t accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don’t know the answer to. That’s how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

title: UX Designer, AI App
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
